structural.shape: C# `const string`, 32 characters; the compiler inlines it into the .NET #US user-string heap as UTF-16LE
structural.whyGitleaksMissedIt: Gitleaks reads neither the #US metadata heap nor UTF-16; an ASCII `strings` pass over the assembly is clean too. The all-ref history scan also never flagged it, because the value entered history under MediaBrowser.Providers/… and has only been renamed since, so no commit diff re-adds it.
structural.disposition: Accepted as immutable inherited pre-fork history; exact-fingerprint or exact commit/path/hash baseline permitted; no path-wide, rule-wide or regex-wide suppression; no history rewrite.

structural.shape: 6-character key folded into BaseUrl at compile time; inlined both as the bare key (sha256 prefix f874f7f329ff) and as the composed base URL (sha256 prefix 60f5fbb114e2)
structural.whyGitleaksMissedIt: Six characters. No entropy or length threshold reaches that without firing on ordinary strings, so no Gitleaks rule can see it at any configuration.
